sources.entry: FoodCoopShop - User-friendly software for food-coops. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: FoodCoopShop is open source web shop software for food coops and local shops, built for selling products from multiple producers with delivery schedules and a bank-transfer payment system.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a web shop optimized for selling food from different producers, with product delivery rhythms such as weekly or every first/last Friday. It provides separate admin areas for manufacturers and administrators, and handles order adjustments like cancellation or changing weight and price. A "decentralized network" plugin can synchronize products across multiple installations. It also offers a cashless payment system based on bank account transfers and a self-service mode for stock products with optional barcode scanning. The software is web-based and available in German and English.
use_cases: running an online shop for a food coop
managing producer and admin accounts for a local shop
setting up recurring product delivery schedules
self-service stock sales with barcode scanning
syncing products between several shop installations
how_to_run: Docker dev and prod environments are available (see the installation guide in the docs)
Ona (formerly Gitpod): once containers are up (about 1 minute), run `bash ./devtools/init-dev-setup.sh` from a Bash terminal
In custom_config.php, set App.fullBaseUrl to your Ona domain (no trailing slash)
stack: PHP intl, Imagick, GD, mbstring, curl, bzip2 extensions
notable: Cashless payment system based on bank account transfers
Decentralized network plugin for syncing products between installations
Self-service mode for stock products with optional barcode scanning
Maintained since 2014 by its original author, Mario Rothauer
caveats: Requires a server with shell access and cronjobs, and Apache with mod_rewrite
Needs PHP 8.5 or newer and MySQL 8.0 or newer, plus several PHP extensions
Assumes basic knowledge of Apache, MySQL and Linux server administration
